messages:
Priya: Heads-up — NovaHealth POC wrapped yesterday. They want the signed order form + PO (net60) to proceed to pilot. Procurement also dropped a security questionnaire with a few unanswered items. Can legal/ops advise on next steps?
Avery: Thanks — can you drop the current order form version here? I want to check billing contact and invoice wording before routing.
Priya: Uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/novah-health-orderform-v3.pdf. Quote = $48,000/yr (pilot priced monthly pro rata). POC credit applied $8k.
Liam: From SE side: we confirmed SSO (SAML) works, KV encryption at rest with customer KMS is doable, but they asked about tenant-level audit logs and per-tenant egress controls — that's where the SQ had blanks.
Maya: @Priya thanks. Security Qs flagged: "audit retention per tenant", "exportability of logs to customer SIEM", and "separation of customer metadata in shared infra". Draft answers ready but legal should sign off on wording for DPA/PCI/SOC2 callouts.
Jordan: Got it. I can review answers — want to avoid new warranties. Quick Q: is Nova insisting on adding a paragraph that MSA liability cap excludes "data leakage through shared cache"? If so we need engineering-approved mitigations.
Priya: They did put that in the procurement email. I'll paste snippet: "Client requires exclusion from liability cap for data leakage stemming from shared inference cache"
Liam: We can add isolation configs (prefix isolation + per-customer KV namespaces) and a config note in the order form. But we should avoid opening an unlimited liability exception.
Jordan: Agreed. Proposed legal-safe approach: accept language about "reasonable efforts and documented isolation controls" and add a commitment to perform a security review on dedicated config for pilot. That keeps liability in bucket but shows remediation path.
Avery: For signature routing: Nova needs the PO attached to the DocuSign envelope, with countersign by their finance team and our CFO. Docu-bot can create envelope once we confirm filenames.
docu-bot: Created envelope #ENV-2024-553 for novah-orderform-v3.pdf + PO_307654.pdf. Waiting for signers: priya@redwood / cfo@redwood / fin@novah.
Priya: @Jordan @Maya can you both ack the SQ answers by EOD? Customer wants to start pilot 5/6. If we miss EOD, finance may ask for payment hold.
Jordan: I'll post redline suggestions to the order form and DPA by 17:00 PST.
Maya: I'll upload the SQ with answers and annotate the remaining engineering checkboxes by 16:30.
Liam: I'll add the isolation config snippet below for Jordan to reference: 
```
# Suggestion for POC isolation
- enable_prefix_isolation: true
- kv_namespace: novah-prod-<tenant-id>
- audit_export: forward->splunk://novah-splunk-collector
```
Priya: perfect. @Avery after legal signs off, please route DocuSign and attach PO (net60). Also confirm invoice email is billing@novah.org.
Avery: noted. I'll wait for final redlines and then create the final envelope. If legal needs a higher-level SLA exception for pilot, escalate to sales leadership. :thumbsup:
Jordan: One more: if they insist on contract language that alters SLA uptime measurement window, push back — we'll offer a tailored SLA for Dedicated deployments but not for hosted pilots.
Priya: Understood — I'll relay that to the customer's procurement. Thanks all.
Maya: tagging security: if we end up enabling customer KMS, procurement needs to confirm KMS key rotation policy and requester IAM principals.
Priya: Copy. I'll ask them to fill the KMS appendix in the SQ.
Avery: Final note — PO file should be named PO_NovaHealth_307654.pdf to match accounting.
Priya: Added to checklist. Closing loop once DocuSign is out. :white_check_mark:
